name: Smol2Operator
notes: The README is the project write-up. The inspected tree contains recipe.ipynb, action-conversion and Aguvis preprocessing code, a function parser, an action-space converter, a collator and evaluation prompts. The README names derived datasets (smolagents/aguvis-stage-1 and smolagents/aguvis-stage-2), the SmolVLM2-2.2B-Instruct-Agentic-GUI checkpoint and a demo Space; those Hub assets are not separate records here, and their licenses were not reviewed. The uses relations record that the recipe transforms the xlangai Aguvis stage 1 and stage 2 releases. ScreenSpot-v2 results are publisher-reported. The repository has no license file, so code permissions are unknown.
summary: Hugging Face recipe that converts Aguvis GUI data into one normalized action space and fine-tunes SmolVLM2-2.2B in two phases, first for screenshot grounding and then for agentic GUI action code.
